events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On September 13, 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur died in Las Vegas, six days after a drive-by shooting. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago this week, the music world lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's influence on hip-hop and culture remains immense. Which track of his still resonates most with you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his death
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27. He would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost the one and only Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road: 57th anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57! That album cover is one of the most famous in history. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Pretenders Frontwoman
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your go-to Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and solo artist Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite tune from the main man?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine': 51st anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album and title track 'Imagine' on October 9, 1971, in the US and October 29 in the UK. This marks 51 years since its release.

angles.name: Imagine the Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still inspires peace and unity worldwide. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music. This marks its 25th anniversary.

angles.name: Remember the iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Time to celebrate 007's enduring legacy. What's your favourite Bond film or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940. He would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the incredible life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace still resonates. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album': 58th anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968. This marks its 58th anniversary.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58! An incredibly diverse and experimental record. Which track from this double album stands out for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his death
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45. He would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul': 61st anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal shift in their sound. This is its 61st anniversary.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Evolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed boundaries. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 years since his death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically killed on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40. He would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 46 years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the one John Lennon song that always stays with you?
